claim: Retrieval-augmented generation reduces factual hallucinations by 42% in human evaluations on open-domain question answering benchmarks.
gold_quote: On open-domain question answering benchmarks including Natural Questions, WebQuestions, and CuratedTrec, RAG models generate responses that are more factual, specific, and diverse than closed-book seq2seq baselines, reducing factual hallucinations by 42% in human evaluations.

claim: Sentence-level evaluation overestimates factual precision by 14.6 percentage points compared to atomic claim verification in FActScore.
gold_quote: Across biographical passages from commercial and open-source language models, human judgements reveal that sentence-level evaluation overestimates factual precision by 14.6 percentage points compared to atomic claim verification.

claim: Lexical BM25 retrieval alone captures 100% of multi-hop rationale spans on the SciFact scientific claim dataset.
gold_quote: Baseline pipeline systems that retrieve evidence via lexical BM25 alone miss 23.4% of multi-hop rationale spans where terminology shifts between the claim and the abstract.

claim: Injecting topically similar but factually irrelevant passages into RAG prompts increases unfaithful synthesis claims from 8.1% to 27.4%.
gold_quote: In controlled distraction experiments across 4,200 scientific queries, injecting topically similar but factually irrelevant passages into the prompt increases unfaithful synthesis claims from 8.1% to 27.4%.

claim: Combining GraphRAG personalized random walks with dense search and BM25 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion raises multi-hop recall at k=8 from 71.2% to 88.6%.
gold_quote: When combined with dense vector search and BM25 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, graph-augmented retrieval improves multi-hop evidence recall at k=8 from 71.2% to 88.6% across multi-document scientific benchmarks.

claim: Mechanical substring and fuzzy quote alignment eliminates 94.2% of hallucinated evidence attributions in scientific agents.
gold_quote: Enforcing mechanical substring and fuzzy alignment between verifier quotes and source abstracts eliminates 94.2% of hallucinated evidence attributions.

claim: For compute-optimal transformer training, model parameters should be quadrupled while keeping training tokens constant.
gold_quote: By training over 400 language models ranging from 70 million to over 16 billion parameters on 5 to 500 billion tokens, we find that for compute-optimal training, the model size and the number of training tokens should be scaled equally: for every doubling of model size the number of training tokens should also be doubled.

claim: Chinchilla (70B parameters, 1.4 trillion tokens) significantly outperforms Gopher (280B) and GPT-3 (175B) on downstream evaluation benchmarks.
gold_quote: We test this hypothesis by training a predicted compute-optimal model, Chinchilla (70B parameters, 1.4 trillion tokens), which uniformly and significantly outperforms Gopher (280B) and GPT-3 (175B) on downstream evaluation benchmarks.

claim: AlphaFold achieved a median backbone accuracy of 0.96 angstrom r.m.s.d.95 in CASP14.
gold_quote: In the 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14), AlphaFold demonstrated a median backbone accuracy of 0.96 angstrom r.m.s.d.95, compared with 2.8 angstrom r.m.s.d.95 for the next best competing method.

claim: AlphaFold structure predictions maintain peak accuracy even when multiple sequence alignment depth drops below 5 homologous sequences.
gold_quote: However, prediction accuracy degrades significantly when multiple sequence alignment depth falls below 30 effective homologous sequences.

claim: Prime editing mediates all 12 possible base-to-base DNA conversions without requiring double-strand breaks and yields off-target indel rates below 0.5%.
gold_quote: Prime editing directly writes new genetic information into a specified DNA site, mediates targeted insertions, deletions, and all 12 possible base-to-base conversions without requiring double-strand breaks (DSBs), and produces substantially lower off-target indel rates (< 0.5%) than Cas9 nuclease cleavage.

claim: FlashAttention uses tiling between GPU HBM and on-chip SRAM to train GPT-2 3.0x faster than standard PyTorch without approximation.
gold_quote: FlashAttention trains BERT-large 15% faster and GPT-2 3.0x faster than standard PyTorch implementations without any approximation.

claim: Mistral 7B uses a sliding window attention size of 4,096 tokens and outperforms Llama 2 13B across reasoning and code benchmarks.
gold_quote: Mistral 7B leverages grouped-query attention (GQA) for faster decoding and sliding window attention (SWA) with a window size of 4,096 tokens to handle sequences of arbitrary length with a reduced KV-cache memory footprint.

claim: Retrieval-augmented generation reduces energy consumption in sovereign quantum datacenter cryostats by 73%.
Prime editing completely cures autosomal dominant Huntington's disease in Phase III human clinical trials with zero adverse events.
LoRA freezes pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture.
gold_quote: We propose Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture.

claim: On GPT-3 175B, LoRA reduces trainable parameters by 10,000x and GPU memory requirements by 3x compared to full fine-tuning.
gold_quote: On GPT-3 175B, LoRA reduces the number of trainable parameters by 10,000x and the GPU memory requirement by 3x compared to full fine-tuning, while introducing zero additional inference latency because the low-rank matrices can be merged with the frozen weights prior to deployment.

claim: LoRA introduces a 35% inference latency penalty because low-rank adapter matrices cannot be merged with frozen weights prior to deployment.
gold_quote: On GPT-3 175B, LoRA reduces the number of trainable parameters by 10,000x and the GPU memory requirement by 3x compared to full fine-tuning, while introducing zero additional inference latency because the low-rank matrices can be merged with the frozen weights prior to deployment.

claim: Speculative decoding accelerates T5-XXL (11B) inference by 2.0x to 3.0x while guaranteeing an output token distribution identical to standard decoding.
gold_quote: Speculative decoding accelerates T5-XXL (11B) inference by 2.0x to 3.0x while guaranteeing that the output token distribution is identical to standard autoregressive decoding.

claim: Speculative decoding sacrifices exact sampling fidelity and alters the target model's output token distribution to achieve faster T5-XXL inference.
gold_quote: Speculative decoding accelerates T5-XXL (11B) inference by 2.0x to 3.0x while guaranteeing that the output token distribution is identical to standard autoregressive decoding.

claim: Direct Preference Optimization optimizes language models directly on human preference pairs using a binary cross-entropy objective without explicit reward modeling or reinforcement learning loops.
gold_quote: By applying a change-of-variables parameterization between the optimal policy and the ground-truth reward function, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) optimizes the language model directly on human preference pairs using a simple binary cross-entropy objective without explicit reward modeling or reinforcement learning sampling loops.

claim: Direct Preference Optimization requires training a separate neural reward model and running proximal policy optimization sampling loops at every step.
gold_quote: By applying a change-of-variables parameterization between the optimal policy and the ground-truth reward function, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) optimizes the language model directly on human preference pairs using a simple binary cross-entropy objective without explicit reward modeling or reinforcement learning sampling loops.

claim: DPO remains completely invariant and immune to out-of-distribution preference shifts even when offline preference data lacks policy coverage.
gold_quote: However, DPO performance degrades on out-of-distribution preference shifts when offline preference data lacks sufficient coverage of the current policy distribution.

claim: Mamba achieves linear time complexity O(L) in sequence length and 5x higher inference throughput than Transformers of similar size.
gold_quote: Mamba achieves linear time complexity O(L) in sequence length L and 5x higher inference throughput than Transformers of similar size, matching a Transformer twice its size on language modeling.

claim: Fixed-state recurrent compression in Mamba achieves superior exact in-context copying recall compared to full softmax attention on synthetic needle lookup tasks exceeding 64k tokens.
gold_quote: However, fixed-state recurrent compression exhibits lower exact in-context copying recall than full softmax attention on synthetic needle-in-a-haystack lookup tasks exceeding 64k tokens.

claim: AlphaFold 3 achieves 76.4% pose accuracy (RMSD < 2.0 angstrom) on the PoseBusters protein-ligand benchmark, outperforming AutoDock Vina.
gold_quote: By replacing the AlphaFold 2 Evoformer and invariant point attention structure module with a lighter Pairformer trunk and a direct atomic diffusion module, AlphaFold 3 achieves 76.4% pose accuracy (RMSD < 2.0 angstrom) on the PoseBusters protein-ligand benchmark, outperforming AutoDock Vina and RoseTTAFold All-Atom.

claim: AlphaFold 3 diffusion generation never produces stereochemical chirality violations or spurious alpha-helical hallucinations in disordered regions.
gold_quote: However, diffusion generation occasionally produces stereochemical chirality violations and spurious alpha-helical hallucinations in intrinsically disordered protein regions unless cross-distillation with AlphaFold-Multimer templates is applied.

claim: Canonical BE3 cytosine base editors induce tens of thousands of C-to-U off-target RNA edits across 38% of expressed transcripts in human cells.
gold_quote: Using whole-transcriptome RNA sequencing across human HEK293T and primary hepatocyte lines, we demonstrate that canonical BE3 cytosine base editors induce tens of thousands of C-to-U off-target RNA edits across 38% of expressed transcripts, independent of guide RNA complementarity.

claim: SECURE mutations (R33A/K34A) in rAPOBEC1 reduce transcriptome-wide off-target RNA deamination by more than 90-fold while preserving on-target DNA editing.
gold_quote: Structure-guided SECURE mutations (R33A/K34A) in rAPOBEC1 reduce transcriptome-wide off-target RNA deamination by more than 90-fold while preserving on-target genomic DNA editing efficiency.

claim: Canonical BE3 cytosine base editors produce zero off-target RNA edits because rAPOBEC1 deamination strictly requires guide RNA complementarity.
gold_quote: Using whole-transcriptome RNA sequencing across human HEK293T and primary hepatocyte lines, we demonstrate that canonical BE3 cytosine base editors induce tens of thousands of C-to-U off-target RNA edits across 38% of expressed transcripts, independent of guide RNA complementarity.

claim: On the 105-qubit Willow processor, increasing surface code distance by 2 suppresses logical error rate per cycle by a factor of 2.14 and achieves a logical lifetime 2.4x longer than the best physical qubit.
gold_quote: Using the 105-qubit superconducting Willow processor, we demonstrate a distance-7 surface code memory whose logical error rate per cycle is suppressed by a factor of Lambda = 2.14 +- 0.02 each time the code distance increases by 2 (from d=3 to d=5 and d=7), achieving a logical lifetime 2.4x longer than the best constituent physical qubit.

claim: Increasing surface code distance from d=3 to d=7 on the Willow processor causes logical error rates per cycle to double rather than decrease.
gold_quote: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires physical gate error rates to operate below the threshold of a quantum error-correcting code so that logical error rates decrease exponentially with code distance d.

claim: Ionizing radiation and cosmic-ray impact events generate correlated quasiparticle bursts that establish a surface code error floor of 0.1 parts per billion per cycle unless gap-engineering traps are incorporated.
gold_quote: However, high-energy ionizing radiation and cosmic-ray impact events generate correlated quasiparticle bursts across the substrate that temporarily establish an error floor around 10^-10 per cycle unless gap-engineering traps are incorporated.

claim: Ring Attention overlaps peer-to-peer key-value block communication with blockwise attention computation to scale context length linearly with accelerator count.
gold_quote: When block size exceeds the arithmetic intensity threshold of the interconnect, Ring Attention scales context length linearly with the number of accelerators with zero communication overhead beyond standard single-device FlashAttention.

claim: GNoME identifies 2.2 million crystal structures below the prior convex hull of stability, including 381,000 novel stable inorganic materials.
gold_quote: Across iterative structural and compositional filtrations, GNoME identifies 2.2 million crystal structures below the prior convex hull of stability, including 381,000 high-confidence novel stable materials—an order-of-magnitude expansion of humanity's known stable inorganic compounds.

claim: GNoME identified fewer than 1,500 stable crystal structures below the convex hull of stability across its active-learning filtrations.
gold_quote: Across iterative structural and compositional filtrations, GNoME identifies 2.2 million crystal structures below the prior convex hull of stability, including 381,000 high-confidence novel stable materials—an order-of-magnitude expansion of humanity's known stable inorganic compounds.

claim: GraphCast generates a 10-day global weather forecast at 0.25-degree resolution in under 60 seconds on a single Cloud TPU v4 device and outperforms ECMWF HRES on 90.3% of verification targets.
gold_quote: GraphCast generates a 10-day global forecast in under 60 seconds on a single Cloud TPU v4 device and outperforms the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) HRES deterministic system on 90.3% of 1,380 verification targets.

claim: Deterministic mean-squared-error training in GraphCast eliminates spectral smoothing and sharpens fine-scale convective extremes beyond 7 days.
gold_quote: However, deterministic mean-squared-error training causes progressive spectral smoothing of fine-scale convective extremes at lead times beyond 7 days.

claim: Adding a second nicking guide RNA in the PE3 prime editing system increases point-mutation efficiency by 2.6-fold to 4.2-fold but raises on-target indel byproduct rates to between 4.8% and 11.3%.
gold_quote: However, dual opposing nicks in PE3 generate transient double-stranded breaks that elevate undesired on-target insertion-deletion (indel) byproduct rates from < 0.5% in PE2 to between 4.8% and 11.3% in PE3.

claim: Dual opposing nicks in the PE3 prime editing system reduce on-target indel byproduct rates to below 0.05% compared to PE2.
gold_quote: However, dual opposing nicks in PE3 generate transient double-stranded breaks that elevate undesired on-target insertion-deletion (indel) byproduct rates from < 0.5% in PE2 to between 4.8% and 11.3% in PE3.

claim: Placing the gold passage in the middle of a long multi-document context degrades language model answering accuracy by up to 22.8 percentage points compared to primacy or recency positions.
gold_quote: Across multi-document question answering and key-value retrieval tasks containing 20 to 50 passages, accuracy follows a U-shaped curve: models achieve highest accuracy when relevant evidence is placed at the very beginning (primacy) or very end (recency) of the input context, whereas placing the gold passage in the middle of the context degrades answering accuracy by up to 22.8 percentage points, falling below closed-book performance on several models.

claim: Language models achieve their highest multi-document question answering accuracy when relevant evidence is buried in the exact middle of a 50-passage context window.
gold_quote: Across multi-document question answering and key-value retrieval tasks containing 20 to 50 passages, accuracy follows a U-shaped curve: models achieve highest accuracy when relevant evidence is placed at the very beginning (primacy) or very end (recency) of the input context, whereas placing the gold passage in the middle of the context degrades answering accuracy by up to 22.8 percentage points, falling below closed-book performance on several models.

claim: Genome-scale Perturb-seq combines multiplexed CRISPRi screening with droplet single-cell RNA sequencing across 2.5 million cells to profile transcriptional signatures for 9,867 expressed genes.
gold_quote: By combining multiplexed CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) library screening with droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing across 2.5 million K562 and RPE1 cells, genome-scale Perturb-seq profiles transcriptional signatures for 9,867 expressed genes.

claim: Up to 31% of inline citations in standard RAG outputs fail strict entailment checks because models attribute parametric statements to passages that do not mention them.
gold_quote: Furthermore, language models frequently fabricate citations by attributing true parametric statements to retrieved passages that do not mention them; up to 31% of inline citations in standard RAG outputs fail strict entailment checks.

claim: Adding an adversarial Skeptic agent that queries for counter-evidence and forces draft revision reduces unsupported final claims by 61.5% at a median latency overhead of 1.38x.
gold_quote: Adding an adversarial Skeptic agent that queries for counter-evidence and forces draft revision reduces unsupported final claims by an additional 61.5% at a median latency overhead of 1.38x.

claim: Automated factuality verifiers that pair nonparametric passage retrieval with entailment checking achieve a Pearson correlation of r = 0.21 with human factuality judgements.
gold_quote: Automated verifiers that combine nonparametric passage retrieval with entailment checking correlate with human factuality scores at r = 0.94.

claim: FlashAttention relies on low-rank randomized kernel approximations to reduce attention complexity from quadratic to sub-linear.
gold_quote: FlashAttention trains BERT-large 15% faster and GPT-2 3.0x faster than standard PyTorch implementations without any approximation.

claim: Mistral 7B uses a sliding window attention span of 32,768 tokens and lags behind Llama 2 13B on mathematics and code generation benchmarks.
gold_quote: Mistral 7B leverages grouped-query attention (GQA) for faster decoding and sliding window attention (SWA) with a window size of 4,096 tokens to handle sequences of arbitrary length with a reduced KV-cache memory footprint.

claim: Combining dense vector retrieval with sentence-level rationale selection on SciFact reduces label Macro-F1 by 9.8 points compared to BM25 alone.
gold_quote: Combining dense retrieval with sentence-level rationale selection boosts label Macro-F1 by 9.8 points.

claim: GNoME crystal discovery guarantees room-temperature ambient-pressure superconductivity above 320 Kelvin in all 381,000 predicted inorganic compounds.
AlphaFold 3 completely replaces wet-lab X-ray crystallography and achieves 100% FDA Phase III approval rates for de novo small-molecule kinase inhibitors.
The 105-qubit Willow superconducting processor breaks 2048-bit RSA encryption in 4.2 milliseconds using Shor's factoring algorithm.
FlashAttention reduces GPU high-bandwidth memory traffic by 64% specifically when compiled for AMD MI300X FP8 tensor cores.
Mamba selective state space models outperform Transformer baselines on multimodal 4K video optical flow estimation benchmarks.
Chinchilla scaling laws demonstrate that mixture-of-experts routing with 64 experts halves optimal training token requirements at fixed FLOPs.
GraphCast medium-range weather forecasts reduce Atlantic hurricane landfall evacuation costs by $4.8 billion per season.
Ring Attention requires InfiniBand NDR 400Gb/s optical interconnects and fails to converge over RoCEv2 Ethernet fabrics.
Genome-scale Perturb-seq in primary human cortical organoids identifies 412 autism spectrum disorder risk enhancers.
Speculative decoding with a 125M draft model increases GPU thermal design power consumption by 48% on mobile edge NPUs.
LoRA rank-8 adaptation on 70B code generation models degrades pass@1 on HumanEval by 11.4% compared to full parameter fine-tuning.
